title: Founder Runtime Approval Decision Application Boundary
objective: Define and validate the founder approval decision application boundary while keeping approval application, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, and execution unlock blocked until later explicitly scoped phases grant narrow authority.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, worker/tool execution, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or provider spend in P121.1.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show raw private project IDs, approval application keys, raw DB table names, raw JSON, raw logs, or raw policy dumps in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions, apply decision buttons, approval application buttons, approve/reject buttons, save decision buttons, or live run controls.
knownLimitations: Approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL interface, deploy, release, export, package action, network calls, and provider spend remain unavailable.
